evidence.title: Async Select built with React & shadcn/ui

name: Async Select
summary: Copy-paste async select component for React built on shadcn/ui's Popover and Command, with debounced search and a preload mode.
description: A generic async select component you drop into a React project. It composes shadcn/ui's Popover and Command, and takes a fetcher function for debounced async search, or preloaded options with local filtering. The page documents installation, required and optional props, and the TypeScript interface.
contains: async select component built from shadcn/ui Popover and Command
async mode: options fetched with a debounced query
preload mode: preloaded options with local filtering
installation, usage and TypeScript interface docs
